Name: Scent Valley(Chinese)
Author: wuming1024
Description:
[b][size=5][color=#ff3b30]THIS MOD IS CHINESE-ONLY. / 本 MOD 只提供简体中文。[/color][/size][/b]



All item names, descriptions, letters and NPC dialogue are Simplified Chinese. On a non-Chinese game client the text will show as missing-glyph boxes — please only install if you play Stardew Valley in Chinese.



[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]



A complete perfumery loop that plugs into the vanilla economy: [b]grow flowers → distill them → blend perfume → wear it / gift it / sell it[/b]. Vanilla flowers, fruit and minerals all go into recipes, so it is not a parallel economy — it sits inside the farm loop you already have.



[b][size=4]Main features[/size][/b]



[list]
[*][b]7 new flowers[/b] — mint, lavender, starbloom, Christmas rose, starlight vine, iris, ylang — with hand-drawn 6-frame growth art, plus [b]9 vanilla flowers[/b] you already know.
[/*]
[*][b]16 oils + 22 extracts[/b] made in two stills (6 in-game hours per batch). Quality carries over from the flower: a gold flower gives a gold oil.
[/*]
[*][b]59 perfumes[/b], each with its own name, colour, price tier (170–11,480g) and scent effect.
[/*]
[*][b]10 limited editions[/b] — only on the matching festival day, a dating anniversary or your wedding day, and only when every quality-relevant ingredient is gold. Iridium quality, ×1.5 price, 10-hour scent, plus sky phenomena.
[/*]
[*][b]8 recipe books[/b] sold across the valley (Pierre, the Bookseller, Sandy, the Island trader, the Casino, the Museum). Reading a book unlocks its recipes and consumes it.
[/*]
[*][b]62 recipes[/b] in total: 59 perfumes + the perfume table + both stills.
[/*]
[*][b]A custom perfume-table UI[/b] — 3 slots, an open recipe book with per-recipe clues, live preview, batch crafting (×1/×5/×10), a filter bar, and full keyboard / gamepad navigation.
[/*]
[*][b]34 NPCs[/b] each have one favourite perfume and a hand-written line when they receive it.
[/*]
[*][b]Scent buffs[/b] — right-click a perfume to wear it for 8 hours (10 for limited editions): friendship, fish quality, extra ore, monster drops, stamina saving, faster bites, scaled by quality.
[/*]
[*]Full [b]GenericModConfigMenu[/b] support, including a UI font-size slider (80–150%).
[/*]
[/list]


[b][size=4]How to play[/size][/b]



[b]1.[/b] On [b]day 2[/b] Caroline mails you a letter. [b]Read the letter[/b] and you receive the perfume table, the small still, the first recipe book and two starter oils. Once you have [b]earned 10,000g in total[/b], a second letter brings the large-still recipe, the perfumer's notebook, 5 starbloom seeds and fairy dust.

[b]2.[/b] Plant a flower, harvest it, drop it in the still → oil.

[b]3.[/b] Right-click the perfume table, put 2–3 oils / extracts into the slots, press [b]Craft[/b].

[b]4.[/b] Right-click a perfume to wear it — or gift it. 34 NPCs have a favourite.



[b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b]



[b]1.[/b] Install [b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b] and [b]Content Patcher 2.0+[/b].

[b]2.[/b] Unzip into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/b] so the result is [b]Mods/香氛谷/内容包[/b] [b]and[/b] [b]Mods/香氛谷/框架[/b]. Keep [b]both[/b] sub-folders — the content pack and the C# framework are two mods shipped in one folder.

[b]3.[/b] Launch the game through SMAPI.



The folder name is Chinese (香氛谷, "Scent Valley"). If your unzip tool mangles it, rename the folder to anything you like — SMAPI does not care about folder names.



[b][size=4]Config[/size][/b]



In-game via GenericModConfigMenu, or in [b]Mods/香氛谷/框架/config.json[/b]: perfume-table font size, enable/disable the table UI, book right-click, consume book on read, hide perfume recipes from the vanilla crafting menu, quality rules, limited editions, scent effects, aura intensity, machine sounds, music ducking.



[b][size=4]Known limitations[/size][/b]



[list]
[*][b]Chinese only[/b] — there is no English translation.
[/*]
[*]The perfume table always shows the vanilla 36 inventory slots; extra slots from backpack-expansion mods are not drawn (your items are unaffected).
[/*]
[*]The large still accepts [b]one[/b] ingredient type at a time (vanilla machine limitation).
[/*]
[*]Starbloom seeds are Casino-only; starlight-vine seeds are Traveling Cart-only (1,800g each).
[/*]
[*][b]Uninstall note:[/b] sell or trash all custom items first, otherwise they turn into "unknown item" placeholders in your save.
[/*]
[/list]


[b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b]



Additive content only — every ID is prefixed with [b]ScentValley_[/b] and no vanilla values are edited. The C# side patches only its own entry points (book reading, the perfume table, quality rules, gift lines, machine sounds) and every patch is wrapped in try/catch. No known conflicts.

[b][size=5]中文说明[/size][/b]



[b][color=#ff3b30]本 MOD 只提供简体中文。[/color][/b]物品名、描述、信件、NPC 台词全是中文；非中文客户端会显示成方块，请不要安装。



[b]一条完整的调香链：[/b]种花 → 蒸馏 → 调香 → 挂香气 / 送人 / 卖钱。原版的花、果、矿物都能进配方，所以它是插在原有农场循环里的一环，不是一套平行的独立经济。



[b][size=4]内容[/size][/b]



[list]
[*][b]7 种新花[/b]（留兰香、薰衣草、星辉花、圣诞玫瑰、星露藤花、鸢尾、依兰）+ 9 种原版花，各 6 帧生长贴图
[/*]
[*][b]16 种精油 + 22 种萃取液[/b]，两台蒸馏器，每批 6 游戏小时；品质跟着原料走
[/*]
[*][b]59 款香水[/b]，各有名字、颜色、价位（170–11,480g）与效果
[/*]
[*][b]10 款限定版[/b]：节日 / 恋爱纪念日 / 婚礼当天，且参与判定的材料全金星 → 铱星、卖价 ×1.5、香气 10 小时、带天象
[/*]
[*][b]8 本配方书[/b]：皮埃尔、书商、桑迪、姜岛商人、赌场、博物馆；读完即解锁，书会消失
[/*]
[*][b]62 条配方[/b]：59 条香水 + 调香台 + 两台蒸馏器
[/*]
[*][b]调香台界面[/b]：3 个材料槽 + 摊开的配方书（含线索）+ 实时预览 + 批量 ×1/×5/×10 + 筛选条，键盘与手柄都能操作
[/*]
[*][b]34 个 NPC[/b] 各有本命香水，收到时会说一句专属台词
[/*]
[*][b]香气 Buff[/b]：右键挂 8 小时（限定 10 小时），加好感 / 鱼品质 / 额外矿石 / 怪物掉落 / 省体力 / 咬钩速度
[/*]
[*]支持 [b]GMCM[/b]（含界面字号 80–150% 可调）
[/*]
[/list]


[b][size=4]怎么玩[/size][/b]



[b]1.[/b] [b]第 2 天[/b]卡洛琳寄来一封信，[b]读完信[/b]才拿到调香台、小蒸馏器、《春日手札》和两瓶起步精油；累计赚到 10,000g 后寄第二封：大蒸馏器的做法、《调香师手记》、星辉花种子与仙尘。

[b]2.[/b] 种花 → 收获 → 放进蒸馏器 → 出精油。

[b]3.[/b] 右键调香台，放 2–3 种精油 / 萃取液，点「调制」。

[b]4.[/b] 右键香水自己用，或送人——34 个 NPC 有本命款。



[b][size=4]安装[/size][/b]



解压到 [b]Stardew Valley\Mods\[/b]，确认是 [b]Mods\香氛谷\内容包[/b] + [b]Mods\香氛谷\框架[/b] 两层结构，两个子文件夹都要留。



[b][size=4]已知限制[/size][/b]



[list]
[*]只有简体中文，没有英文翻译
[/*]
[*]调香台固定显示原版 36 格，背包扩展 MOD 多出的格子不显示（物品本身不受影响）
[/*]
[*]大蒸馏器一次只能收同一种原料（原版机器限制）
[/*]
[*]卸载前先清空自定义物品，否则会变成「未知物品」
[/*]
[/list]
